hook: The Best Children's Math Books, from Toddlers to Teens
hookText: The Best Children's Math Books, from Toddlers to Teens

beats.say: Eighty-five children's math books on six shelves by age, from counting books and picture books about infinity to the first book that asks for a proof.
Mitsumasa Anno · 1977 · Ages 2-6. Ellen Stoll Walsh · 1991 · Ages 2-5.
Donald Crews · 1968 · Ages 2-5. Pat Hutchins · 1986 · Ages 3-7. April Pulley Sayre and Jeff Sayre · 2003 · Ages 3-7.
